shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,300p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,180p' app/layout.tsx && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"viewTransition|ViewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -60 && cat package-lock.json | head -35 && rg -n \"next\" node_modules/next/package.json | head"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '150,215p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts && rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | head -80 && rg -n '\"version\"|\"peerDependencies\"' node_modules/next/package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,300p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,220p' app/ViewTransitions.tsx && git diff --stat && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json package-lock.json | head -200 && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ViewTransitions.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/ViewTransitions.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '45,285p' && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,70p' && nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,100p' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'"
